known_parameters: Nominal capacity rating (200.0 kWh from synthetic fixture)
Max charge/discharge power limit (50.0 kW from synthetic fixture)
Semi-empirical degradation equation structures (Wang / Schmalstieg LFP/NMC formulations)
partially_known_parameters: Round-trip efficiency (84.64% synthetic assumption; literature range 85%-94%)
Cycle-life bounds (3,000-6,000 EFC at 80% EOL from generic LFP literature)
DoD stress exponent (f(DoD) ~ DoD^1.5 from generic LFP/NMC literature)
unknown_parameters: Target battery cell manufacturer and model name
Target battery cell chemistry (LFP vs NMC vs Ni-Cd)
Sub-zero thermal enclosure heating penalty & ambient cell operating temperature profile
Measured battery stack replacement cost ($/kWh) including polar logistics
required_next_measurements: Acquire official battery manufacturer datasheet or nameplate snapshot from target site
Extract 1-minute BMS telemetry (cell voltage, current, temperature, SOC)
Obtain procurement/logistics invoice for battery stack replacement cost ($/kWh)
unnecessary_measurements: Destructive laboratory cell cycling testing (Tier C literature is sufficient for model structure)
High C-rate stress testing >1C (POLARIS operating range is <= 0.25C)
